facts.business: Dai-ichi Karkaria Limited is a specialty chemicals company with decades of experience in surfactants and performance additives, serving sectors such as textiles, agrochemicals, personal care, and oilfield chemicals, and leveraging Japanese technologies for application-led innovation.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals (Surfactants, Performance Additives, Oilfield Chemicals, Polymer Additives)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpt

key_risks: Global geopolitical uncertainties (Russia-Ukraine war, Gaza war, Iran-Israel conflict) impacting commodity and logistics markets
Feedstock dependency on imported naphtha, LPG, and propane exposing the company to crude oil price fluctuations
Revenue recognition cut-off risk and fraud risk due to pressure to achieve performance targets
Higher compliance costs from evolving policy environment including carbon capture and decarbonization regulations
